LifePreserver.name: LIFE-PRESERVER
LifePreserver.description: Choose a card in your deck that isn't <c=cardtrait>buoyant</c>. It gains <c=cardtrait>buoyant</c>.

FlashDrive.name: FLASH DRIVE
FlashDrive.description: Draw 2 extra cards on the first turn.

MaterialUpgrade.name: MATERIAL UPGRADE
MaterialUpgrade.description: Permanently gain <c=keyword>+2</c> <c=hull>max hull</c> and <c=keyword>+1 max shield</c> on pickup.

CardRefund.name: CARD REFUND
CardRefund.description: Each time you <c=cardtrait>exhaust</c> a card, draw 1 more card next turn.

Incinerator.name: INCINERATOR
Incinerator.description: On pickup, remove up to 2 cards from your deck, then gain a non-temp <c=card>Fumes</c>.

MegaThrusters.name: MEGA-THRUSTERS
MegaThrusters.description: Gain 1 <c=status>ACE</c> on the first turn. <c=downside>On pickup, add a wing to the far left of your ship.</c>

BrainDrain.name: BRAIN DRAIN
BrainDrain.description: Draw <c=card>+2 cards</c> every turn. <c=downside>At the end of each turn, exhaust the cheapest card in hand.</c>

TormentNexus.name: TORMENT NEXUS
TormentNexus.description: On pickup, replace all <c=card>basic cards</c> in your deck with random upgraded cards from your crewmates.
